label: 2025-26 Backtest
note: Phase5 and Phase3 were trained through 2023-24 and selected on 2024-25, so 2025-26 is out of sample for them. The legacy models (Linear, Tree, MLP) used 2025-26 as their validation season, and the win-probability constants for the legacy models were fit on it, so their results (and the Ensemble's) may be slightly optimistic.
